"""Private opportunity probe, no canonical indexes or runtime modifications."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse, hashlib, io, json, math, os, resource, struct, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
REPO=Path('/Users/jakefitzgerald/.codex/worktrees/3c6b/text-to-cad')
SCRATCH=Path('/private/tmp/cadgen-performance-20260910')
OUT=REPO/'models/tmp/rwgltf-opportunity-20260910'
def sha(raw): return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
def dump(path, obj): path.write_text(json.dumps(obj, indent=2)+'\n')
def objpath(store, digest): return store/'objects'/digest[:2]/digest[2:]
def ms(t): return (time.perf_counter()-t)*1000

def worker(request_path, js_path, report_path):
    import numpy as np
    from OCP.BinTools import BinTools
    from OCP.TopoDS import TopoDS, TopoDS_Shape
    from OCP.TopAbs import TopAbs_FACE, TopAbs_EDGE, TopAbs_REVERSED
    from OCP.TopExp import TopExp
    from OCP.TopTools import TopTools_IndexedMapOfShape
    from OCP.BRepTools import BRepTools
    from OCP.BRepMesh import BRepMesh_IncrementalMesh
    from OCP.BRep import BRep_Tool
    from OCP.TopLoc import TopLoc_Location
    from OCP.BRepGProp import BRepGProp
    from OCP.GProp import GProp_GProps
    from OCP.TCollection import TCollection_AsciiString, TCollection_ExtendedString
    from OCP.TDocStd import TDocStd_Document
    from OCP.XCAFApp import XCAFApp_Application
    from OCP.XCAFDoc import XCAFDoc_DocumentTool
    from OCP.TDataStd import TDataStd_Name, TDataStd_NamedData
    from OCP.RWGltf import RWGltf_CafWriter
    from OCP.RWMesh import RWMesh_CoordinateSystem
    from OCP.TColStd import TColStd_IndexedDataMapOfStringString
    from OCP.Message import Message_ProgressRange
    req=json.loads(request_path.read_text()); reference=json.loads(js_path.read_text())
    samples=[]
    for repeat in range(2):
        stages={}; t=time.perf_counter()
        raw=Path(req['brep']).read_bytes()
        assert sha(raw)==req['brepSha256']
        stages['readVerify']=ms(t); t=time.perf_counter()
        shape=TopoDS_Shape(); BinTools.Read_s(shape, io.BytesIO(raw)); BRepTools.Clean_s(shape)
        stages['reconstructClean']=ms(t); t=time.perf_counter()
        faces=TopTools_IndexedMapOfShape(); edges=TopTools_IndexedMapOfShape()
        TopExp.MapShapes_s(shape, TopAbs_FACE, faces); TopExp.MapShapes_s(shape, TopAbs_EDGE, edges)
        assert faces.Extent()==reference['faceCount'] and edges.Extent()==reference['edgeCount']
        stages['canonicalMaps']=ms(t); t=time.perf_counter()
        mesher=BRepMesh_IncrementalMesh(shape, reference['absoluteChordMm'], False, .35, False)
        assert mesher.IsDone()
        stages['nativeMesh']=ms(t); t=time.perf_counter()
        doc=TDocStd_Document(TCollection_ExtendedString('XmlOcaf'))
        app=XCAFApp_Application.GetApplication_s()
        app.NewDocument(TCollection_ExtendedString('MDTV-XCAF'), doc)
        app.InitDocument(doc)
        XCAFDoc_DocumentTool.SetLengthUnit_s(doc, .001)
        shape_tool=XCAFDoc_DocumentTool.ShapeTool_s(doc.Main())
        shape_tool.SetAutoNaming_s(False)
        counts={}; samples_by_ord={}
        for ordinal in range(1, faces.Extent()+1):
            face=TopoDS.Face_s(faces.FindKey(ordinal))
            label=shape_tool.AddShape(face, False)
            TDataStd_Name.Set_s(label, TCollection_ExtendedString(f'f{ordinal}'))
            TDataStd_NamedData.Set_s(label).SetInteger(TCollection_ExtendedString('faceOrd'), ordinal)
            loc=TopLoc_Location(); tri=BRep_Tool.Triangulation_s(face,loc)
            if tri is None or not tri.NbTriangles(): raise RuntimeError(f'Unmeshed face {ordinal}')
            counts[ordinal]=(tri.NbNodes(), tri.NbTriangles())
            expected=[]
            for tid in sorted({1, tri.NbTriangles(), max(1,tri.NbTriangles()//2)}):
                ids=list(tri.Triangle(tid).Get())
                if face.Orientation()==TopAbs_REVERSED: ids[1],ids[2]=ids[2],ids[1]
                points=[]
                for node in ids:
                    p=tri.Node(node).Transformed(loc.Transformation())
                    points.append((p.X(),p.Y(),p.Z()))
                expected.append((tid-1,[i-1 for i in ids],points))
            samples_by_ord[ordinal]=expected
        stages['faceDocumentAndSampleTruth']=ms(t); t=time.perf_counter()
        glb_path=OUT/f"{req['cid']}-{repeat}.glb"
        writer=RWGltf_CafWriter(TCollection_AsciiString(str(glb_path)), True)
        writer.SetMergeFaces(False); writer.SetParallel(False)
        writer.ChangeCoordinateSystemConverter().SetInputCoordinateSystem(RWMesh_CoordinateSystem.RWMesh_CoordinateSystem_Zup)
        assert writer.Perform(doc,TColStd_IndexedDataMapOfStringString(),Message_ProgressRange())
        stages['cppGlbWrite']=ms(t); t=time.perf_counter()
        data=glb_path.read_bytes(); magic,version,total=struct.unpack_from('<III',data)
        assert magic==0x46546c67 and version==2 and total==len(data)
        json_len,kind=struct.unpack_from('<II',data,12); assert kind==0x4e4f534a
        manifest=json.loads(data[20:20+json_len]); offset=20+json_len
        bin_len,kind=struct.unpack_from('<II',data,offset); assert kind==0x004e4942
        binary=memoryview(data)[offset+8:offset+8+bin_len]
        def accessor(index):
            a=manifest['accessors'][index]; view=manifest['bufferViews'][a['bufferView']]
            width={'SCALAR':1,'VEC2':2,'VEC3':3}[a['type']]
            dtype=np.dtype({5126:'<f4',5125:'<u4',5123:'<u2'}[a['componentType']])
            return np.ndarray((a['count'],width),dtype=dtype,buffer=binary,
                offset=view.get('byteOffset',0)+a.get('byteOffset',0),
                strides=(view.get('byteStride',width*dtype.itemsize),dtype.itemsize))
        def matrix(node):
            if 'matrix' in node:return np.asarray(node['matrix']).reshape((4,4),order='F')
            x,y,z,w=node.get('rotation',[0,0,0,1]); sx,sy,sz=node.get('scale',[1,1,1])
            m=np.eye(4);m[:3,:3]=np.array([[1-2*y*y-2*z*z,2*x*y-2*z*w,2*x*z+2*y*w],
                [2*x*y+2*z*w,1-2*x*x-2*z*z,2*y*z-2*x*w],
                [2*x*z-2*y*w,2*y*z+2*x*w,1-2*x*x-2*y*y]])@np.diag([sx,sy,sz])
            m[:3,3]=node.get('translation',[0,0,0]);return m
        seen=set(); totals={'vertices':0,'triangles':0,'nonUnitNormals':0,'reversedNormalTriangles':0,
            'float32CollapsedTriangles':0,'sampleTriangles':0,'sampleIndexMismatches':0,'maxSampleCoordinateErrorMm':0.,'signedVolumeMm3':0.}
        # Each face is a free named leaf; reject a surprising hierarchy rather than infer face order.
        for node in manifest['nodes']:
            assert not node.get('children')
            ordinal=node.get('extras',{}).get('faceOrd')
            assert ordinal in counts and ordinal not in seen and node.get('name')==f'f{ordinal}'
            seen.add(ordinal)
            primitives=manifest['meshes'][node['mesh']]['primitives']
            assert len(primitives)==1 and primitives[0].get('mode',4)==4
            primitive=primitives[0]
            p=accessor(primitive['attributes']['POSITION']).astype(np.float64)
            n=accessor(primitive['attributes']['NORMAL']).astype(np.float64)
            ids=accessor(primitive['indices']).reshape((-1,3))
            assert (len(p),len(ids))==counts[ordinal]
            transform=matrix(node);p=p@transform[:3,:3].T+transform[:3,3]
            n=n@np.linalg.inv(transform[:3,:3]);n/=np.linalg.norm(n,axis=1)[:,None]
            # glTF metres Y-up -> input CAD millimetres Z-up.
            p=p[:,[0,2,1]]*np.array([1000,-1000,1000]);n=n[:,[0,2,1]]*np.array([1,-1,1])
            totals['vertices']+=len(p);totals['triangles']+=len(ids)
            normals0=accessor(primitive['attributes']['NORMAL'])
            totals['nonUnitNormals']+=int(np.count_nonzero(abs(np.linalg.norm(normals0,axis=1)-1)>1e-3))
            q=p.astype(np.float32).astype(np.float64)
            cross=np.cross(q[ids[:,1]]-q[ids[:,0]],q[ids[:,2]]-q[ids[:,0]])
            lengths=np.linalg.norm(cross,axis=1)
            totals['float32CollapsedTriangles']+=int(np.count_nonzero(lengths<reference['scale']**2*1e-12))
            totals['reversedNormalTriangles']+=int(np.count_nonzero(np.einsum('ij,ij->i',cross,n[ids].sum(axis=1)) < -1e-6*lengths))
            totals['signedVolumeMm3']+=float(np.einsum('ij,ij->i',q[ids[:,0]],np.cross(q[ids[:,1]],q[ids[:,2]])).sum()/6)
            for tid,expected_ids,expected_p in samples_by_ord[ordinal]:
                totals['sampleTriangles']+=1
                totals['sampleIndexMismatches']+=int(list(ids[tid])!=expected_ids)
                totals['maxSampleCoordinateErrorMm']=max(totals['maxSampleCoordinateErrorMm'],float(np.max(np.abs(p[ids[tid]]-np.array(expected_p)))))
        assert seen==set(counts)
        assert totals['sampleIndexMismatches']==0
        assert totals['maxSampleCoordinateErrorMm']<reference['scale']*2e-6
        props=GProp_GProps();BRepGProp.VolumeProperties_s(shape,props)
        totals['exactVolumeMm3']=abs(props.Mass())
        totals['relativeVolumeError']=abs(abs(totals['signedVolumeMm3'])-abs(props.Mass()))/max(abs(props.Mass()),1e-15)
        stages['readDecodeAndAudit']=ms(t)
        assert Path(req['brep']).read_bytes()==raw
        samples.append({'stagesMs':stages,'glbBytes':len(data),'glbSha256':sha(data),'glbPath':str(glb_path),
            'faceCount':len(seen),'canonicalFaceNamesVerified':True,'inputBrepUnchanged':True,'quality':totals})
        # This binding initializes the supplied document without registering
        # it as an open application session. Ordinary owner release applies.
        del writer, shape_tool, doc, label, face, tri, shape, faces, edges
    dump(report_path,{'cid':req['cid'],'samples':samples,'repeatByteDeterministic':samples[0]['glbSha256']==samples[1]['glbSha256'],
        'peakRssBytes':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,
        'selectorParity':False,'missing':'Edge IDs/polylines and triangle-side edge links from same triangulation; singular-normal/degenerate correction and broader quality corpus not implemented.'})

def main():
    if len(sys.argv)>1 and sys.argv[1]=='--worker':
        worker(*(Path(p) for p in sys.argv[2:5]));return
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    store=REPO/'models/tmp/performance-hand-20260910/store'
    tree_hash='9822de20097b9a213e64b6d4655ef8cbf9ed1c6eeb1ae2322605802b37cc1951'
    tree_raw=objpath(store,tree_hash).read_bytes();assert sha(tree_raw)==tree_hash
    tree=json.loads(tree_raw)
    specs=[]
    cid='01f668a7dd6c9203';base=REPO/'models/tmp/perf-audit/view/components'
    specs.append({'cid':cid,'name':'planet_gear_3_18_teeth','brep':str(base/f'{cid}.brep'),'surf':str(base/f'{cid}.surf')})
    cid='056f821159cb927e';component=tree['components'][cid]
    specs.append({'cid':cid,'name':'actual_slow_hand_component','brep':str(objpath(store,component['brep'])),'surf':str(objpath(store,component['surf']))})
    report={'qualification':'Bounded private render-only opportunity probe. Same numerical L3 chord/angle inputs are not matched-quality proof. No browser, STEP parse, source execution, canonical store writes, selector parity or production backend change.',
        'startedUtc':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ',time.gmtime()),'treeSha256':tree_hash,'rows':[]}
    began=time.perf_counter()
    for spec in specs:
        spec.update(brepSha256=sha(Path(spec['brep']).read_bytes()),surfSha256=sha(Path(spec['surf']).read_bytes()),jsTess=str(OUT/f"{spec['cid']}-js-l3.tess"))
        req=SCRATCH/f"rwgltf-{spec['cid']}-request.json";dump(req,spec)
        js=SCRATCH/f"rwgltf-{spec['cid']}-js.json";native=SCRATCH/f"rwgltf-{spec['cid']}-native.json"
        subprocess.run(['node',str(SCRATCH/'rwgltf-probe.mjs'),str(REPO),str(req),str(js)],check=True,timeout=max(1,60-(time.perf_counter()-began)))
        subprocess.run([sys.executable,__file__,'--worker',str(req),str(js),str(native)],check=True,timeout=max(1,60-(time.perf_counter()-began)))
        report['rows'].append({'request':spec,'js':json.loads(js.read_text()),'native':json.loads(native.read_text())})
        print(json.dumps({'completed':spec['cid'],'elapsedSeconds':time.perf_counter()-began}),flush=True)
    report['elapsedSeconds']=time.perf_counter()-began
    report['helpers']={p.name:{'sha256':sha(p.read_bytes()),'source':p.read_text()} for p in (Path(__file__),SCRATCH/'rwgltf-probe.mjs')}
    relatives=['packages/cadgen-js/src/lib/surf/'+x for x in ('tessellate.js','evaluate.js','container.js','tessellationCache.js','lodPolicy.js')]
    report['sourceHashes']={p:sha((REPO/p).read_bytes()) for p in relatives}
    report['ocpVersion']='7.9.3.1.1'
    dump(SCRATCH/'rwgltf-opportunity-20260910.json',report)
if __name__=='__main__':main()
